title: Accept plain HTTP for the legacy ledger link
context-and-problem-statement: The legacy ledger does not support TLS. The encryption-in-transit control cannot be met until the ledger is replaced.
decision-drivers: Ledger replacement is scheduled for Q2
Traffic stays inside an isolated network segment

considered-options.name: Accept plain HTTP until replacement
considered-options.description: Record a temporary deviation and isolate the network segment.
positive-consequences: No change to the legacy system

considered-options.name: Add a TLS-terminating sidecar
considered-options.description: Put a proxy in front of the ledger.
negative-consequences: Ledger vendor does not support the change

decision-outcome.rationale: The risk is low inside the isolated segment, and the ledger is replaced in Q2.
